articles.summary: Sabra Health Care REIT, Inc. (Nasdaq: SBRA) announced today that Rick Matros, the company’s Chair and Chief Executive Officer; Michael Costa, the company’s Chief Financial Officer; Darrin Smith, the company’s Chief Investment Officer; and Lukas Hartwich, the company’s Executive Vice President of Finance, will attend Citi’s 2026 Global Property CEO Conference on March 1-4, 2026, at The Diplomat Beach Resort in Hollywood, Florida. About Sabra Sabra Health Care REIT, Inc. , a Maryland corporation,
articles.title: Sabra Health Care REIT, Inc. to Attend Citi’s 2026 Global Property CEO Conference
